one_liner.zh: 像设计 UI 组件一样设计字幕：永远单行、逐词跟着声音走、active 词不推挤邻词。Recipe 即 JSON，复制即复刻。
one_liner.en: Design subtitles like UI components: always single-line, word-synced to voice, active words never push neighbors. A Recipe is JSON — copy it to replicate the style.

problem.zh: 视频字幕要么是剪辑软件里难复用的样式堆，要么是自动生成的灰色默认款。想做出「每个词跟着声音动」的专业字幕（卡拉OK填充、数字放大、逐词强调），没有顺手的工具，也没有可复用的样式资产。
problem.en: Subtitles are either locked inside editing software or plain gray defaults. No tool makes word-synced motion captions (karaoke fill, number emphasis, per-word pops) easy — and no reusable style asset format exists.

scenarios.zh: 知识/财经视频作者要「专业感」字幕
scenarios.outcome_zh: 选 preset → 微调 → 导出 SRT/WebVTT/ASS/JSON，Phase 1 内完成
scenarios.outcome_en: Pick a preset, tweak, export SRT/WebVTT/ASS/JSON — all within Phase 1

scenarios.zh: 团队/频道要统一字幕视觉系统
scenarios.en: Teams need a unified caption visual system
scenarios.outcome_zh: Recipe = JSON 一份配方，复制给别人就能复刻同款字幕
scenarios.outcome_en: A Recipe is JSON — share it and others replicate the exact style

scenarios.outcome_zh: AI 助手对话框写字幕 → 用作字幕文本 + 套用推荐样式（无 Key 走本地规则模式）
scenarios.outcome_en: Write in the AI box → use as caption text + apply recommended style (local rules without an API key)

architecture.summary_zh: 分层引擎：transcript(词+时间) → segmenter(永远单行，超长重分段) → emphasis(规则识别数字/百分比/货币/实体) → resolve(currentTime→状态) → renderer(逐词/背景/动效)。Recipe 是产品模型，只存名字的动效由 registry 解析。
architecture.summary_en: Layered engine: transcript → segmenter (single-line, re-segment on overflow) → emphasis (rule-based) → resolve (currentTime→states) → renderer. The Recipe is the product model; motions store names resolved by a registry.

modules.role_zh: renderer / segmenter / emphasis / motions / backgrounds / borders / typography
12 个核心 preset，每文件一个
数据模型 + 4 个 Plugin 接口（Phase 2/3 契约）
zustand+persist：recipe/savedRecipes 持久化，undo/redo 双栈 40 步
四页：/（Hero+6 demo）/ studio / library / recipes
modules.role_en: four pages: home, studio, library, recipes

reuse.item: 三条硬规则（永远单行/语音驱动/不推挤邻词）
reuse.condition: 任何字幕/卡拉OK系统可直接采用为约束

reuse.item: 克制动效标准（pop 峰值 1.09、bounce 5px、float 8px、glow 只给关键词）
Emphasis 规则引擎（percentage/currency/number/entity 正则）
reuse.condition: 纯规则零 API 成本

reuse.item: WordTimestamp[] + CaptionRecipe 两个稳定契约
reuse.condition: Phase 2 whisper / Phase 3 remotion 都接同一契约
